newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RAMAPHOSA JOINS SAB IN BOARD RESHUFFLE.
newsitem.headline: RAMAPHOSA JOINS SAB IN BOARD RESHUFFLE.

text.p: Drinks giant South African Breweries Ltd (SAB) said on Wednesday that Cyril Ramaphosa, a former union leader and politician turned top black businessman, has joined its board as a non-executive director.
Ramaphosa is chairman of conglomerate Johnnies Industrial Crop Ltd , which owns a stake in SAB, and he replaces Pat Retief who has retired.
The firm also said that chief operating executive Graham Mackay is to become group managing director with an expanded brief to cover all the day-to-day operational activities at executive level.
The firm also said Ron Stringfellow, previously managing director of hotels group Southern Sun, will become chairman of SAB's hotel and gaming interests.
Stringfellow will also become chairman of delisted retailer OK Bazaars.
